title: Add per-bit-channel analysis metadata to ModemCapabilities
description:
Extend `ModemCapabilities` with per-bit-channel metadata that downstream analysis work (a9ccb8ae per-bit LLR distribution, 80f218ca analysis integration, e2c0f65a bit-channel analysis story) can consume without re-deriving it from the constellation geometry. Also nail down the canonical noise-parameter contract at the trait layer so those analysis tools can interpret `DemapInput::noise_var` unambiguously.

The original c007875b title ("Define bit-channel metadata and demapper analysis modes") is rescoped here: the deliverables it named -- `BitChannelId`, `BitChannelSemantics`, `DemapMethod`, `ModemCapabilities` -- already shipped in c87c5043. What analysis work actually needs on top of that is metadata *about* each bit channel, not just its identity.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `ModemCapabilities` exposes a per-bit-channel view with at minimum: a **symmetry hint** (the LLR distribution is symmetric about 0 under equiprobable bits), an **independence hint** (this bit is conditionally independent of other bits in the same symbol given the channel output, useful for bit-interleaved coded modulation analysis), and a **closed-form-LLR-available** flag.
- [ ] Built-in presets (BPSK, Gray square-QAM 4/16/64/256) populate the new metadata correctly, and the reference demapper + any reference mapper also surface matching capabilities through `ModemView`.
- [ ] `DemapInput::noise_var` and the modem module docs state the noise convention explicitly (`N0 = 2 * sigma^2`, total complex noise variance, as ee556fbf pinned for the AWGN adapter). This captures SC3 of the original issue.
- [ ] Unit tests cover the new per-bit-channel metadata for each preset, and assert it round-trips through `ModemView` correctly.

## Notes

- Scope restricted to metadata plumbing and documentation. No new demapping *modes* are added here -- the `ExactLogMap` / `MaxLog` set already covers the demapper-side analysis axis.
- Redefined during the project-lead session on 2026-04-13 with explicit user approval (original scope was duplicated by c87c5043). See `dev/active/d4851c3d-handoff.md` for context.
